title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11114__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 6746 defines certain dimensions of earth-moving base-machines as well as the codes identifying those dimensions. At the same time, it specifies a reference system for defining, and a coding system for identifying, additional, similar dimensions in terminology standards and commercial specifications. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
